name: xtyle-pack-example
description: A worked xtyle pack: two algorithms and a theme, declared the way a published pack declares them

xtyle.description: Derive with example-tinted or example-banded, or re-derive the dusk theme the pack seeds; nothing here is discovered, all of it is declared

algorithms.name: example-tinted
algorithms.description: Pushes the accent's hue deep into every tinted fill, so accent and status surfaces read as one family

algorithms.name: example-banded
algorithms.description: Adds a derived threshold ramp to the standard register, so a reading bands into safe, watch, or over

themes.name: dusk
themes.description: example-tinted seeded with a deep indigo page and a warm accent
